newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish Riksbank board meeting ends, no rate change.
newsitem.headline: Swedish Riksbank board meeting ends, no rate change.

text.p: The board of Sweden's central bank, the Riksbank, met on Thursday but the meeting ended with no changes to interest rates announced.
The market had not expected the bank to make any moves.
The Riksbank has not moved its key interest rate, the repo rate, from its current level of 4.10 percent since December 17.
Its other key rates, the deposit and lending rates, stand at 3.75 percent and 5.25 percent respectively.
The market was awaiting the Riksbank's latest quarterly inflation report due out at 0900 GMT.
